Name: (CP) Zynonia's Velociraptor Reskin for 1.6
Author: rainbowlack
Description:
All credit goes to Zynonia for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/825]their original mod and textures[/url].

Requires Content Patcher.

Reskins the dinosaur to look like a little velociraptor. Colour is configurable.
Comes with 8 colours: Albino, Blue, Brown, Gray, Green, Pink, Sand, Tan

Some wording has been modified to match the spellings Stardew Valley uses, and to look nicer in the config menu (i.e. "Colour" → "Color", "grey" → "Gray")

Manifest.Name: Dino Velociraptor Reskin
Manifest.Description: Replace that nasty green lizard with a cute fluffy velociraptor. Content Patcher version w/ config created by Sparrow.
Manifest.Author: zynonia
